In scope: how a client, tool, or Atlas service selects an Atlas analytics node for a read. That covers the pre-defined `nodeType` / `workloadType` replica set tags, the read preference mode and tag-set semantics that select them, fallback behaviour, and the per-surface routing knobs (driver URI, Data Federation store, App Services, Compass, BI Connector). It also covers how each of these changed over time.

- `workloadType:OPERATIONAL` operational read isolation - `diskState:READY` warm-node targeting - Overload-aware server selection (`overloadAwareServerSelectionEnabled`, `SystemOverloadedError`) - `terminateSecondaryReadsOnOrphanCleanup` (8.2+) - How the Atlas SQL Interface / ADF route to analytics nodes - Atlas Search Nodes routing - OVHcloud analytics nodes: https://docs.ovhcloud.com/en/guides/public-cloud/databases/mongodb-analytics

Out of scope: analytics node sizing, pricing, and provisioning (parent concept); Atlas Search Nodes; general read preference not aimed at workload isolation; non-Atlas "analytics node" products (for example OVHcloud).

Long analytics scans may hit it.
